title: Understanding KDE Plot
text: A KDE plot estimates the probability density function of a random variable. It smooths out the distribution by using a kernel, which affects how the data is represented. The bandwidth (\alpha) controls the smoothness of the KDE plot.

title: Effect of High Bandwidth
text: When the bandwidth (\alpha) is too high, the KDE plot becomes overly smooth. This can lead to unrealistic density estimates, such as showing significant density for ages below $$18$$, which might not be present in the actual data.

title: Analyzing the KDE Plot
text: Look at the KDE plot. Does it show a significant density for ages below 18?
